verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a built-in AI you can hand tasks to. Users describe busywork (finding subscriptions, matching invoices to payments) once and it runs automatically for their review. AI Close agents reconcile accounts and review transactions, and an in-app "ask AI" button helps categorize transactions without leaving the tool. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation that delegation works as claimed, and thin documentation on how open-ended delegation is beyond the specific bookkeeping workflows (categorization, close, imports).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Hand off the busywork. Finding software subscriptions, matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
